_label: DENVER APPLICATION-CLAIMS DRAFT — universal meanings authored from the selected evidence; development only; practitioner review required
writerRule: Only applicationClaims may reach the customer-writing model. Evidence, mythology, symbols, source history, technical factors and trace-only factors remain internal.

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Emotional experience may become clearer through expression, including conversation, writing or another personally meaningful way of putting thoughts into words.
Everyday exchanges and the immediate environment may have a noticeable effect on your state of mind.
Confidence may grow through repeated self-directed effort: practicing a skill, expressing an idea and discovering that you can rely on your own voice.
Relationships with siblings or sibling-like peers may form part of your emotional landscape, without the chart determining the quality or history of those relationships.

prohibitedExtensions: claims about your actual sibling history
claim that a sibling relationship was close, distant, supportive, harmful or conflictual
guaranteed writing, speaking or media career
moral or behavioral verdict from the classical third-house passage

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Feelings may be expressed in a measured or initially reserved manner rather than displayed all at once.
Truthful, thoughtful and agreeable communication may be important to how you express what is on your mind.
Learning, developing knowledge or refining an artistic skill may give the mind a constructive place to focus.

prohibitedExtensions: bodily, sexual, property or family prediction
guaranteed intelligence, talent or educational success

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Uttara Phalguni is the Moon's nakshatra, one of the smaller lunar sections used to refine how the Moon's emotional qualities are expressed.
Mutuality and fair exchange may matter deeply; you may feel most settled in bonds where care, effort and respect move in both directions.
You may place emotional value on sustaining agreements and continuing to care for what has been responsibly begun.
Words, learning or literary expression may be sources of enjoyment and emotional fulfillment.

compositionRequirements: APP-UF-RECIPROCITY and APP-UF-SUSTAINING-COMMITMENT require at least one additional non-nakshatra chart factor in the reading.
APP-UF-NAKSHATRA-CONTEXT must appear before any other Uttara Phalguni interpretation.
prohibitedExtensions: claim that every relationship is reciprocal
presenting the modern synthesis as a classical quotation

applicationClaims.allowedMeaning: Within the fourth pada, Uttara Phalguni's concern with reciprocity and sustained commitment may operate through a more receptive and integrative mode.
Imagination or symbolic understanding may help you recognize what another person or situation is asking of them.
You may show determination and resilience by remaining engaged with a valued commitment while it passes through change.
The combined pattern may create tension between carefully evaluating what is true and remaining receptive to feelings, ambiguity or another person's needs.
Development may involve choosing commitments that remain mutual, expressing needs clearly and allowing dedication to include healthy limits.

factors: the Sun as Uttara Phalguni lord
the Sun's seventh drishti to the Moon
Mercury's seventh drishti to the Moon
traceOnlyDirective.rule: These factors must be present in the internal trace but absent from customer prose. No current application record licenses a personal interpretation of them. The Sun's repeated roles do not create a customer-facing thread without an approved multi-role synthesis rule.

implementationRequirements: Merge this overlay additively; do not alter the Lisbon or Chicago application-claims files.
Route every claim from its own purposes field; no Denver claim ID may be hard-coded into planner or verifier code.
Use approximately six purposeful paragraphs and a 300–380-word total budget; contract thin paragraphs instead of padding.
Explain nakshatra in plain language before interpreting Uttara Phalguni, and introduce the pada only after the nakshatra has been defined and interpreted.
Support both requires and requiresAny claim conditions.
Keep source history, mythology, symbols, technical placements, dispositors, nakshatra lords and drishti factors out of customer prose.
Run the chart-general acceptance suite using the actual executed-check count.
Production must emit zero customer claims and zero prose because every record in this overlay is productionEligible false.
